sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 126
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No. 126
[6th May 1962, Gazette of West Pakistan, Extraordinary, dated 11th May 1962]
Whereas it is expedient in the
public interest to lay-out areas for public Parks and Gardens and also to
reconstruct and renovate places of Historical interest, in the City of Lahore ;
And whereas, the Lahore
Improvement Trust (hereinafter referred to as the said Trust) notified a scheme
under section 36 of Punjab Town
Improvement Act. 1922 on 15th April 1955 for the development of the area known
as Anguri Bagh opposite to Shalamar Garden ;
And whereas, the same was
sanctioned by the Provincial Government,--vide
Notification No. S. O. (T)-1-G/58, dated 28th November 1958 ;
Now therefore, I, Lt.-General Bakhtiar Rana, SQA, MC, ADC,
Martial Law Administrator, Zone `B' hereby order as under :
That the Commissioner, Lahore
Division shall take possession forthwith of such land as is included in the Anguri Bagh Development Scheme
referred to above and is bounded on the North by G. T. Road, on the East by Shalamar Escape, on the South by Shalamar
Distributary and on the West by Shalamar
Link Road, Lahore (hereinafter referred to as the
said property), summarily ejecting, if necessary, any person or persons in
occupation of any part thereof.
The said property shall be
transferred to the said Trust who will be put in possession thereof and the
said property shall be deemed to have been duly acquired by the said Trust free
from all encumbrances.
The compensation for the land and
standing crops, trees or structures on the said property will be assessed by
the Land Acquisition Collector, of the said Trust and shall be subject to
confirmation by the Commissioner, Lahore Division, Lahore, whose order shall be final.
(4) The compensation so assessed
shall be paid by the said Trust before the
30th May 1962.
(5) Notwithstanding anything
contained in the Punjab Town Improve?ment Act, 1922, the Chairman of tae said
Trust subject to the over all super-vision of the Commissioner, Lahore Division-
(i) shall forthwith lay-out the
area thus acquired as a Public Park
and, if necessary, also provide sites for residential purposes and sale thereof
to the public ;
(ii) may require
the purchasers of such residential sites to erect such structures
within such period as he may determine and shall do all other things necessary
for the establishment of the said Public Park in so-called area.
(iii) shall determine the terms and conditions of the payment to
the said Trust of the sale price of the sites sold and the method of recovery
in case of default.
6. No provision of this Order
shall be called in question in any Court, including High Court and the Supreme
Court. No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the
Government, the said Trust, or any member, Officer or servant of the Government
or the said Trust or any person
acting under the orders of the Commissioner, Lahore Division or the Chairman of
the said Trust in respect of anything done or intended to be done in good faith
under this Order.
